scope.mutations: No infrastructure configuration, resize, deletion, patch, restart or queue consumption. IAM diagnostic report generation and read-only SSM diagnostics only.

notes: Counts include supported CLI-operation attempts and 17 local unsupported-operation records, not a count of AWS HTTP requests.
Supplemental read-only SSM diagnostics are separately identified in the report.
A quota evidence filename collision was corrected with a separate EC2 quota query; RDS and EC2 evidence are available.

interpretation: Percentiles apply to hourly aggregates with the statistic shown; they are not instantaneous request percentiles.
Sum is published only for CloudWatch Sum statistics; gauge/percentage samples are not added into cumulative utilization.
No samples are not zeros. Global_or_custom metrics must not be attributed to an EC2 role.
Only root filesystem historical utilization was measured for v3; live /mnt/data snapshot is separately reported.

findings.title: Restringir SSH público y proteger el acceso directo a los orígenes
Proteger y probar la recuperación del volumen de datos de v3
Planificar la actualización de RDS MariaDB antes del fin de soporte de 10.6
Rotar las claves IAM antiguas y reducir credenciales permanentes
Completar alertas de capacidad y trazabilidad de AWS
Diseñar cifrado de almacenamiento y TLS/autenticación de datos
Programar mantenimiento de v3 y actualizaciones pendientes de ElastiCache
Habilitar caché segura de archivos públicos en CloudFront
Definir disponibilidad y dimensionamiento de la capa web antes de producción
Revisar y retirar recursos ociosos conservando recuperación
Acotar excepciones Allow de WAF sin desactivar protecciones
Verificar el consumidor de feedback SES/SNS/SQS y su vigilancia

limits: Organizations ListAccounts denied; other accounts and effective SCPs not certified.
Default IMDS account policy unavailable in local CLI; individual instance metadata settings were inspected.
RDS major lifecycle API unavailable; current engine and upgrade paths plus official lifecycle documentation inspected.
Only v3 is SSM managed; RAM, filesystem, patch and server configuration on the other two hosts not verified.
No destructive restore, failover, production load, secret-value retrieval, credential rotation or real-mail test executed.
No proof of external backup coverage for v3 data volume; local backups alone do not establish independent recovery.
No public end-to-end browser certification through Basic Auth/WAF; local isolated regressions and actual-origin FPM validation are distinct.
